jobs.description:
As an Operations Manager at Skechers, you report directly to the Director of Operations and independently manage several departments. 

Your key responsibilities include:
  
• Planning, organizing, and supervising daily operations to meet short- and long-term goals, while ensuring budget, deadlines, and safety standards are met in an automated environment. 
• Promoting and maintaining a strong safety culture. 
• Developing strategic business plans for the short, medium, and long term for your departments. 
• Taking necessary actions to achieve performance objectives by defining and monitoring team KPIs, while effectively managing operational costs. 
• Leading, coaching, evaluating, and developing your teams (approx. 150 people) in collaboration with Team Leaders and Leads. Communication is central to your role—both with your teams and social partners. 
• Managing and optimizing automated processes with a continuous improvement mindset.  
This role requires adaptability, versatility, and a proactive approach to overcoming daily challenges and driving operational excellence.

Education and technical skills: 
 
• Minimum 3 years of proven experience in a similar role within an automated/production environment. 
• Proficiency in WMS, WCS, and AS400 systems. 
• Solid knowledge of Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, Outlook). 
• Strong working knowledge of English.  
Your personality and soft skills:
  
• Leadership – You are a driver of change and adapt easily to a constantly evolving environment. 
• Communication – You adjust your communication to suit your audience and actively listen. 
• Customer & results orientation – You go the extra mile to ensure customer satisfaction. 
• Stress management – You remain positive and composed when facing day-to-day challenges. 
• Conflict resolution & negotiation – You are assertive and diplomatic when managing tensions. 
• Attention to detail – You are uncompromising when it comes to safety and adherence to procedures and workplace rules.

Our client is a leading international group active in industrial solutions. Operating in a dynamic Benelux environment, they combine global standards with local agility. They are looking for an EHS Specialist to strengthen safety culture, support operations and projects, and drive continuous improvement across multiple entities.

Jobomschrijving

• Champion a strong safety and environmental culture
• Maintain and improve EHS systems (ISO 45001, ISO 14001, VCA)
• Support projects with safety methodologies (HAZOP, RAMS, PSSR)
• Act as EHS point of contact for operational field teams
• Conduct risk assessments, audits, and site safety reviews
• Investigate incidents and define preventive measures
• Deliver EHS training and awareness programs
• Ensure compliance with BE/NL regulations and reporting

• 2  years in EHS within an industrial or service environment
• Strong knowledge of safety regulations (Belgium required, NL is a plus)
• Experience with EHS management systems (ISO 45001 / VCA)
• Familiar with project safety tools (HAZOP, RAMS…) is a plus
• Fluent in Dutch and English; French is a strong asset
• Autonomous, pragmatic, and hands-on mindset
• Strong communicator with influencing skills

jobs.occupation: Project Manager - International Industrial Technology Group
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international industrial technology group providing engineered solutions that improve workplace safety, environmental performance and production efficiency. As Project Manager, you will oversee industrial installation projects from order confirmation through commissioning, coordinating customers, subcontractors and internal teams to ensure successful delivery.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage industrial projects from order confirmation to final handover
• Act as the main point of contact for customers throughout execution
• Review purchase orders and contractual requirements
• Coordinate subcontractors, installers and internal stakeholders
• Plan resources, schedules and site activities
• Monitor budgets, milestones, risks and project profitability
• Negotiate scope changes and contractual deviations
• Ensure accurate reporting, documentation and customer acceptance

• Master's or Bachelor's degree in Electromechanics, Electrical Engineering or similar
• Minimum 7 years of project management experience in a technical or industrial environment
• Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously
• Strong understanding of industrial installations, equipment or infrastructure projects
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
• Comfortable handling contractual, financial and administrative follow-up
• Ability to read technical drawings and interact with engineering teams
• CAD knowledge is a strong asset
• Fluent French and Dutch with good English
• Solution-oriented, autonomous and assertive personality

As a truck driver you are responsible to deliver and collect goods to our customers. You make collections and deliveries in all parts of Benelux or European countries. You report to the dispatching team.

 

 

You have C or CE and ADR driving license (with valid code 95).

You have a least 2 years of experience in driving with semi-trailers and are familiar with highways within BENELUX and west EU countries.

You speak Dutch (Flemish), French or English fluently. Any other European language is a plus.

You have your own car.

Do you have experience as a forklift driver?As the driver of the forklift truck with long forks, you are responsible for storing goods and loading/unloading the trucks. In addition, you sometimes help with other tasks in the warehouse (order picking, receiving, stock counting, etc.). For this, you will use a scanner.You will start in the Katoen Natie warehouses in Ghent.

Profile

• You have experience with a forklift truck with long forks (2m40) or you have extensive experience with a forklift truck with short forks and you see yourself driving the long-fork truck as well.
• A forklift certificate is not a requirement, experience is more important. There will be a theoretical and practical test
• To communicate effectively with your colleagues, you speak and understand Dutch or English well.
• You can work in a two-shift system
• You are motivated and reliable, and you prize safety and quality.
• You are flexible when it comes to hours and tasks
• In addition, you know how to use a scanner and a computer

jobs.occupation: Electrical & Automation Technical Sales & Project Manager
jobs.description:
• An international engineering company designs and delivers high-technology equipment for heavy industrial production facilities. 
• Operating on projects worldwide, the organization combines technical expertise, innovation, and complex project execution in an international environment. 

Jobomschrijving

• Define electrical and automation solutions aligned with customer requirements. 
• Review technical specifications, customer documentation, and contractual requirements. 
• Develop and validate E&A budgets covering engineering and equipment costs. 
• Present and technically defend proposals while supporting commercial negotiations.

• Proficiency with project management tools such as MS Project and SAP.

Join a stable and international environment where you can keep learning, take ownership and enjoy a healthy work-life balance.

Our partner is anestablished international technology organisationoperating in a highly technical and collaborative environment.

They are looking for aSystem & Network Engineerto strengthen their infrastructure team and contribute to the reliability, security and continuous improvement of their IT environment.

What makes this opportunity stand out?You get to work on interesting infrastructure and networking challenges, while being part of a company that genuinely values work-life balance.
System & Network Engineer - Your Role
• Manage and maintainWindows & Linux systems, servers and core infrastructure.
• Configure, monitor and troubleshootnetworking environments, including switches, firewalls and related technologies.
• Contribute toinfrastructure projects, upgrades and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Ensure high levels ofavailability, performance and securityacross the IT environment.
• Investigate complex technical issues and providehands-on troubleshootingacross systems and networks.
• Collaborate with internal teams and external partners while documenting and improvingIT processes and solutions.
System & Network Engineer - Your Profile
• Several years of experience as aSystem Engineer, Network Engineer or Infrastructure Engineer.
• Solid knowledge ofWindows and/or Linuxenvironments.
• Strong understanding ofnetworking concepts, protocols and infrastructure technologies.
• Experience withvirtualisation, security or cloud technologiesis a strong plus.
• A proactive, analytical mindset with the ability totake ownershipof technical challenges.

A hands-on Network Architect role where Juniper and Fortinet meet complex, business-critical infrastructure.

Our partner is aninternational technology organisationoperating critical digital infrastructure. As part of the continued development of their infrastructure environment, they are looking for aNetwork Architectto join a highly skilled and collaborative technical team.

 

This is not a purely conceptual architecture role. You will move betweenarchitecture, design, implementation and production support, working with modern networking technologies and having a direct impact on the resilience and evolution of the infrastructure.

 

Your playground? Juniper, Fortinet, BGP, DNS, security and distributed infrastructure.
Network Architect - The Role
• Design and evolvenetwork architecturesacross complex and distributed production environments, from high-level concepts to low-level technical designs.
• Work hands-on withJuniper networking and Fortinet security technologies, including routing, switching, firewalls and network segmentation.
• Contribute toBGP, DNS/DNSSEC, high-availability and distributed infrastructure, with a strong focus on resilience and security.
• Drive improvements aroundautomation, monitoring and observability, using technologies such as Ansible, Terraform, Python, Prometheus or Grafana.
• Collaborate withInfrastructure, Security, Architecture and Software Engineeringteams, while challenging and validating technical solutions delivered by external partners.
• Maintainarchitecture documentation, diagrams and technical standards, while supporting troubleshooting, lifecycle management and production environments.
Network Architect - The Profile
• 7+ years of experiencein network, infrastructure or systems engineering, with strong exposure to critical production environments.
• Strong expertise innetworking, including TCP/IP, routing, switching and protocols such as BGP and OSPF.
• Solid hands-on experience withJuniper and Fortinet— this is a key part of the role.
• Good understanding ofLinux, DNS/DNSSEC, firewalls and high-availability/distributed infrastructure.
• Exposure tovirtualisation, containers, private cloud or Infrastructure as Code(VMware, Kubernetes, Docker, Ansible, Terraform, etc.) is a strong plus.
• Analytical, pragmatic and hands-on mindset, with the ability to move from architecture and design to implementation and production troubleshooting. Fluent English is required.

Ready to take your GRC career beyond traditional compliance?

Our partner, an international technology organisation operating in a highly connected and evolving digital environment, is looking for an experiencedSecurity Managerto reinforce its Legal & Compliance function.

 

You'll be working in amulticultural, international setting, collaborating with different departments and stakeholders while contributing to governance, cybersecurity, privacy and regulatory initiatives.

 

A great opportunity to combine your legal and technical understanding with strategic exposure and real decision-making impact.
Security Manager - The Job
• GRC Strategy:Drive the organisation's governance, risk and compliance framework, from risk identification to mitigation and reporting.
• Security & Certifications:Manage compliance withISO 27001, ISO 22301and other relevant security and resilience frameworks.
• Regulatory Compliance:Translate European regulations such asNIS2, CER and GDPRinto actionable policies, controls and processes.
• Privacy Management:Coordinate GDPR compliance, DPIAs, privacy assessments and support the DPO in data protection governance.
• ESG & Corporate Governance:Develop ESG governance processes, monitor commitments and coordinate reporting activities.
• Stakeholder Advisory:Act as a trusted advisor to internal teams, challenge existing practices and continuously improve GRC tools and processes.
Security Manager - The Ideal Candidate
• Minimum 7 years of relevant experiencein GRC, compliance, risk management or auditing.
• Master's degree inLaw, Compliance, Risk Managementor another relevant discipline.
• Solid understanding ofinformation security governance, GDPR, ISO standards, NIS2 and CER.
• Hands-on experience withGRC platforms, risk frameworks and internal control systems.
• Native-levelDutch or French, professional proficiency in the other national language and excellent English.
• Strong communicator with an international mindset, able to influence stakeholders and manage complex topics with confidence.

An SME in the Waasland region known for the production, purchase, and sale of pallets.

As a future butcher / deboner of pork meat, you will work on different lines with tasks such as cutting shoulders, bellies, and ribs. 

Experience is an asset, but motivated newcomers are welcome. 

Thanks to the Butchers Academy, you will receive comprehensive training, followed by a permanent contract and annual evaluations offering opportunities for advancement.

We are looking for ambitious and eager-to-learn individuals who can start early (start at 4.55 AM) and are flexible in their schedules depending on the season. 

You should be comfortable working in a cold environment and have an affinity for the food industry (pork meat), along with the associated quality and hygiene standards. 

You must be physically capable of standing and working all day and place importance on workplace safety.

• Translate product and business requirements into scalable, maintainable, and practical technical solutions.

• Contribute to engineering excellence in areas such as architecture, testing, CI/CD, and operational reliability.
• Share technical knowledge and mentor team members to raise the overall technical level.

Requirements

• 5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience with a solid backend foundation.
• You have experience designing, building, and operating software in production using Docker and Kubernetes.
• You possess a good understanding of modern SaaS concepts such as API design, distributed systems, authentication, and multi-tenancy.
• You bring experience with data technologies such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or Elasticsearch.
• You have worked with modern delivery practices including CI/CD and automated deployments.
• You're comfortable investigating root causes and reasoning about architectural trade-offs.
• You possess a product mindset, focusing on solving core problems rather than just implementing features.
• You are fluent in Dutch with a good command of English.
Nice to Haves

• Hands-on experience with Golang as a primary backend language.
• Experience with Vue.js for frontend interface development.
• Knowledge of large-scale data processing using Kafka or Parquet.
• Experience with object storage platforms such as Ceph S3.
• Interest in using AI to strengthen engineering practices.
